ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extreme low-intensity dominance; the ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels is approximately 0.05:0.95 across the visible ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees and a deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations; distinct peaks and deep valleys are visible along the entire continuous trailing edge boundary from tip to notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edges sweeping laterally and dorsally, concluding in sharp distal tips with a slight posterior hook.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant detection of non-aligned linear high-intensity streaks (rake marks); prominent diagonal scarring on the right lobe and shorter horizontal segments on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tearing and jagged serration of the trailing edge indicates significant historical tissue loss or trauma; multiple linear rake marks consistent with interspecies interaction.
